title: Sandisk Stock Trends Following Earnings Report
description: Sandisk stock has been trending following the release of their earnings report, which showed a revenue forecast that fell short of expectations, according to Yahoo Finance.

sections.heading: Earnings Report
paragraphs: The earnings report from Sandisk has had a significant impact on their stock, with Yahoo Finance reporting that the revenue forecast fell short of expectations, causing the stock to sink.

sections.heading: Market Impact
paragraphs: Investing.com notes that Sandisk's earnings could have an impact on other major players in the market, including Micron, Western Digital, and Seagate.

sections.heading: Positive Outlook
paragraphs: Despite the negative reaction to the revenue forecast, TradingView reports that Sandisk had record Q4 results and a strong outlook, driven by Datacenter, Edge, and AI-fueled NAND demand.
